intro: The 240 most frequent words of the Vulgate cover 67% of every verse you will ever read in it.

lessons.t: The words you cannot read a verse without

words.g: and, and even; also, even; (et ... et = both ... and)
in, on, at (space); in accordance with/regard to/the case of; within (time)
ex: And I said to you at that time:

words.g: be; exist; (also forms the perfect passive: factus est = was made)
ex: Eat not the things that are unclean.

words.g: who; that; which, what
ex: Eat not the things that are unclean.

words.g: he/she/it/they; that
owner, lord, master; the Lord; title for ecclesiastics/gentlemen
ex: The Lord also said to Aaron:

words.g: you (pl.)
ex: And I said to you at that time:

words.g: we, us
ex: Perhaps the waters had swallowed us up.

words.g: to, up to, towards; near, at; until, on, by
ex: The Lord also said to Aaron:

words.g: not, by no means, no; [non modo ... sed etiam => not only ... but also]
ex: Wizards thou shalt not suffer to live.

words.g: say, declare, state; allege, declare positively; assert
ex: The Lord also said to Aaron:

words.g: each, every, every one (of a number); all (pl.); all/the whole of
ex: sint omnia nostra sub lege tua.
Let all we have be subject to thy law,

words.g: son
ex: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

words.g: but (postpositive), on the other hand/contrary; while, however; moreover, also
ex: Gomor autem decima pars est ephi.
Now a gomor is the tenth part of an ephi.

words.g: your (sing.)
ex: sint omnia nostra sub lege tua.
Let all we have be subject to thy law,

words.g: God (Christian text); god; divine essence/being, supreme being
ex: Her discipline is the gift of God.

words.g: that; those (pl.); also DEMONST
ex: I will chastise him therefore and release him.

words.g: down/away from, from, off; about, of, concerning; according to
ex: Of Zabulon, Eliab the son of Helon.

words.g: his men (pl.), his friends
ex: And forsaketh the guide of her youth,

words.g: make/build/construct/create/cause/do; have built/made; fashion
ex: These things did Banaias the son of Joiada.

words.g: this; these (pl.); (also DEMONST)
ex: These things did Banaias the son of Joiada.

words.g: that, so that; in order that; as, when
ex: Orate vero ut hieme non fiant.
But pray ye that these things happen not in winter.

words.g: my (personal possession); mine, of me, belonging to me; my own
ex: Nonne manus mea fecit hæc omnia?
Hath not my hand made all these things?

words.g: when, at the time/on each occasion/in the situation that; after; since/although
ex: Grace be with you all. Amen.

words.g: from, away from; by (agent)
ex: Erant autem omnes fatigati a vino,
And they were all overcharged with wine.

words.g: go, walk; march, advance; pass
ex: Quod si eam viderit non crevisse,
But if he see that it is not grown,

words.g: above, on top, over; upwards; moreover, in addition, besides
ex: Pax enim Dei super faciem terræ.
For the peace of God is over all the face of the earth.

words.g: earth, land, ground; country, region
ex: Pax enim Dei super faciem terræ.
For the peace of God is over all the face of the earth.

words.g: king
ex: rex Madon unus, rex Asor unus,
The king of Madon one, the king of Asor one,

words.g: day; daylight; (sunlit hours)
ex: A psalm of a canticle on the sabbath day.

words.g: because
ex: Because he shall not be moved for ever.

words.g: namely (postpos.); indeed; in fact
ex: Pax enim Dei super faciem terræ.
For the peace of God is over all the face of the earth.

words.g: come
ex: And they departed from thence and came to Lebna.

words.g: give; dedicate; sell
ex: Her discipline is the gift of God.

words.g: people, nation, State; public/populace/multitude/crowd; a following
ex: Et dixit omnis populus: Fiat, fiat.
And all the people said: So be it, so be it.

words.g: see, look at; consider; (PASS) seem, seem good, appear, be seen
ex: The burden that Habakkuk the prophet saw.

words.g: house, building; home, household; (N 4 1, older N 2 1)
ex: Et surrexit, et abiit in domum suam.
And he arose, and went into his house.

words.g: himself/herself/itself; the very/real/actual one; in person
ex: In finem. Servo Domini ipsi David.
Unto the end, for the servant of God, David himself.

words.g: through (space); during (time); by, by means of
ex: quia per errorem deliquit in Dominum.
Because by mistake he trespassed against the Lord.

words.g: if, if only; whether; [quod si/si quis or quid => but if/if anyone or anything]
ex: If he offer a lamb before the Lord:

words.g: hand, fist; team; gang, band of soldiers
ex: Nonne manus mea fecit hæc omnia?
Hath not my hand made all these things?

words.g: man, human being, person, fellow; [novus homo => nouveau riche]
ex: And out of the sixteen thousand persons,

words.g: have, hold, consider, think, reason; manage, keep; spend/pass (time)
ex: et in omni gente primatum habui:
And in every nation I have had the chief rule:

words.g: but, but also; yet; however, but in fact/truth
ex: sed et Aduram, et Lachis, et Azeca,
And Aduram, and Lachis, and Azecha,

words.g: your (pl.), of/belonging to/associated with you
ex: Let all your things be done in charity.

words.g: father; [pater familias, patris familias => head of family/household]
ex: Qui me odit, et Patrem meum odit.
He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

words.g: out of, from; by reason of; according to
ex: Advena et mercenarius non edent ex eo.
The stranger and the hireling shall not eat thereof.

words.g: speak, tell; talk; mention
ex: Loquere major natu: decet enim te
Speak, thou that art elder: for it becometh thee,

words.g: as, just as; like; in same way
ex: Labora sicut bonus miles Christi Jesu.
Labour as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

words.g: our
ex: sint omnia nostra sub lege tua.
Let all we have be subject to thy law,

words.g: therefore; well, then, now
ex: I will chastise him therefore and release him.

words.g: venom (sg.), poisonous secretion of snakes/creatures/plants; acrid element
say (defective), assert; say yes/so, affirm, assent; prescribe/lay down (law)
ex: Qui ait: Ostende mihi gloriam tuam.
And he said: Shew me thy glory.

words.g: send, throw, hurl, cast; let out, release, dismiss; disregard
ex: Misit autem Salomon ad Hiram, dicens:

words.g: hear, listen, accept, agree with; obey; harken, pay attention
ex: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

words.g: word; proverb; [verba dare alicui => cheat/deceive someone]
all the way, right on; all the time, continuously, at every point, always
ex: Laudabit usque ad mortem anima mea Dominum,
My soul shall praise the Lord even to death.

words.g: one
ex: rex Madon unus, rex Asor unus,
The king of Madon one, the king of Asor one,

words.g: on behalf of; before; in front/instead of
ex: In finem, pro filiis Core. Psalmus.
Unto the end, for the sons of Core.

words.g: himself, herself, themselves
ex: Omnis qui audiet cavebit se ab eo.
But every one that shall hear it, will beware of him.

words.g: name, family name; noun; account, entry in debt ledger
ex: And to Simon he gave the name Peter:

words.g: community/city/town/state; citizens; citizen rights/citizenship
ex: Gloriosa dicta sunt de te, civitas Dei!
Glorious things are said of thee, O city of God.

words.g: because, since, seeing that
ex: Remember wrath, for it will not tarry long.

words.g: large/great/big/vast/huge; much; powerful
ex: Loquere major natu: decet enim te
Speak, thou that art elder: for it becometh thee,

words.g: brother; cousin
ex: King Alexander to his brother, Jonathan, greetings.

words.g: much, many, great, many a; large, intense, assiduous; tedious
ex: Novi diluculo, multa est fides tua.
Heth. They are new every morning, great is thy faithfulness.

words.g: lest, that not; (with imperative) do not
ex: Eat not the things that are unclean.

words.g: heart; mind/soul/spirit; intellect/judgment
ex: Dabis eis scutum cordis, laborem tuum.
Thau. Thou shalt give them a buckler of heart, thy labour.

words.g: behold! see! look! there! here! [ecce eum => here he is]
ex: Audite: ecce exiit seminans ad seminandum.
Hear ye: Behold, the sower went out to sow.

words.g: as if, just as if, as though; as it were; about
ex: sed super terram fundes quasi aquam,
But thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water,

words.g: sin; do wrong, commit moral offense; blunder, stumble
ex: The fear of the Lord driveth out sin:

words.g: nor, and..not; not..either, not even
ex: Iterum autem nec his debet ignosci.
But then again they are not to be pardoned.

words.g: soul, spirit, vital principle; life; breathing
ex: Wine drunken with excess is bitterness of the soul.

words.g: put/place/set; station/post (troops); pitch (camp)
ex: in qua pones testimonium quod dabo tibi.
In which thou shalt put the testimony that I will give thee.

words.g: whole, entire; all together; all
ex: All the works of the Lord are exceeding good.

words.g: shape, face, look; presence, appearance; beauty
ex: Abram fell flat on his face.

words.g: tribe, clan; nation, people; Gentiles
ex: et in omni gente primatum habui:
And in every nation I have had the chief rule:

words.g: leader/chief, first/leading member/citizen/man; master/expert; founder/proposer
ex: Under their prince Eliasaph the son of Lael.

words.g: facing, face-to-face, in the eyes; towards/up to; across
ex: Mansimusque in valle contra fanum Phogor.
And we abode in the valley over against the temple of Phogor.

words.g: answer
ex: The children of Heth answered, saying:

words.g: that, that of yours, that which you refer to; such
ex: Iste est ergo sermo quem facietis:
And this is the thing that you shall do:

words.g: way, road, street; journey
ex: And the way of peace they have not known.

words.g: slave; servant
ex: In finem. Servo Domini ipsi David.
Unto the end, for the servant of God, David himself.

words.g: be able, can; [multum posse => have much/more/most influence/power]
ex: Ego autem, quid possum adjuvare vos?
But as for me, what help can I give you?

words.g: year (astronomical/civil); age, time of life; year's produce
ex: In the seventh year thou shalt make a remission,

words.g: consecrated, sacred, inviolable; venerable, august, divine, holy, pious, just
ex: Salutate omnem sanctum in Christo Jesu.
Salute ye every saint in Christ Jesus.

words.g: heaven, sky, heavens; space; air, climate, weather
ex: et humilia respicit in cælo et in terra?
and looketh down on the low things in heaven and in earth?

words.g: priest, priestess
ex: For he was son in law of the high priest.

words.g: follow; escort/attend/accompany; aim at/reach after/strive for/make for/seek
ex: qui reddet unicuique secundum opera ejus:
Who will render to every man according to his works.

words.g: likewise/besides/also/too; not only; even/actually
time, condition, right time; season, occasion; necessity
ex: And I said to you at that time:

words.g: his property (pl.); [se suaque => themselves and their possessions]
ex: He added his commandments and precepts.

words.g: need; work; fortifications (pl.), works
ex: All the works of the Lord are exceeding good.

words.g: bad, evil, wicked; ugly; unlucky
ex: Ab omni specie mala abstinete vos.
From all appearance of evil refrain yourselves.

words.g: know, understand
ex: Quare? quia non diligo vos? Deus scit.
Wherefore? Because I love you not? God knoweth it.

words.g: two (pl.)
take or receive in advance; anticipate; warn
ex: He added his commandments and precepts.

words.g: seat, rank, position; soldier's post; quarters
ex: And calling the name of that place Bethel.

words.g: three
ex: The children of Hasum, two hundred twenty-three.

words.g: nor [neque..neque=>neither..nor; neque solum..sed etiam=>not only..but also]
ex: Neque enim fratres ejus credebant in eum.
For neither did his brethren believe in him.

words.g: true, real, genuine, actual; properly named; well founded
ex: Orate vero ut hieme non fiant.
But pray ye that these things happen not in winter.

words.g: breath, breathing, air, soul, life
ex: And be renewed in spirit of your mind:

words.g: in person, face-to-face; in one's presence, before one's eyes; publicly/openly
ex: If he offer a lamb before the Lord:

words.g: come upon; discover, find; invent, contrive
ex: et inventi sunt tria millia ducenti.
And they were found three thousand two hundred.

words.g: eye
ex: Oculus fui cæco, et pes claudo.
I was an eye to the blind, and a foot to the lame.

words.g: water; sea, lake; river, stream
ex: Perhaps the waters had swallowed us up.

words.g: climb; go/climb up; mount, scale
ex: Ascendit autem ex illo loco in Bersabee,
And he went up from that place to Bersabee,

words.g: inhabit, dwell; live, stay
ex: Tu autem in sancto habitas, laus Israël.
But thou dwellest in the holy place, the praise of Israel.

words.g: stand, stand still, stand firm; remain, rest
ex: Et in omni terra steti: et in omni populo,
And have stood in all the earth: and in every people,

words.g: near; on account of; by means of
ex: hæc enim omnia propter mandatum Dei fiunt.
For all these things are to be done because of the commandment of God.

words.g: go/march/come out; set sail; land, disembark
ex: And they departed from thence and came to Lebna.

words.g: middle, middle of, mid; common, neutral, ordinary, moderate; ambiguous
ex: Sic Paulus exivit de medio eorum.
So Paul went out from among them.

words.g: mountain; huge rock; towering heap
ex: Et in monte: Samir et Jether et Socoth
And in the mountain Samir and Jether and Socoth,

words.g: take, grasp, receive, accept, undertake; admit, let in, hear, learn; obey
ex: I receive not glory from men.

words.g: conversation, discussion; rumor; diction
ex: Iste est ergo sermo quem facietis:
And this is the thing that you shall do:

words.g: call, summon; name; call upon
ex: And Judas, who was called Machabeus;

words.g: thousand; a thousand; [mille passuum => thousand paces = a mile]
army, infantry; swarm, flock
ex: adhuc enim dispersus erat exercitus a castris.
For as yet the army was dispersed from the camp

words.g: be unwilling; wish not to; refuse to
ex: Be not deceived: God is not mocked.

words.g: voice, tone, expression
ex: Then they sounded with trumpets, and cried out with a loud voice.

words.g: behind, afterwards, after
ex: And when she had conceived, and brought forth a son,

words.g: near, (very) close to, next to; hard by, adjoining; on a par with
ex: et milvum ac vulturem juxta genus suum,
And the kite, and the vulture, according to their kind.

words.g: hidden, secret, concealed; covert, disguised; abstruse, recondite
ex: Dixitque Lot ad eos: Quæso, domine mi,
And Lot said to them: I beseech thee, my Lord,

words.g: law; motion, bill, statute; principle
ex: sint omnia nostra sub lege tua.
Let all we have be subject to thy law,

words.g: altogether (usu. pl.), in a body; every, all, entire; total/complete
ex: But with all that are present and that are absent.

words.g: good, good thing, profit, advantage; goods (pl.), possessions, wealth, estate
ex: Good things continue with their seed,

words.g: in front/presence of, in view; before (space/time/degree); over against, facing
ex: And before it the altar of holocaust.

words.g: other, another; different, changed; [alii...alii => some...others]
ex: Et alia die cum exirent a Bethania, esuriit.
And the next day when they came out from Bethania, he was hungry.

words.g: daughter
ex: Nomen autem filiæ Aser fuit Sara.
And the name of the daughter of Aser, was Sara.

words.g: thus, so; as follows; in another way
ex: Sic Paulus exivit de medio eorum.
So Paul went out from among them.

words.g: now, today, at present
ex: Et nunc hic sumus orantes pro vobis.
And now here we are praying for you.

words.g: advance, walk; enter, step/go into; undertake, begin
ex: And entering he walked through Jericho.

words.g: beat, strike; pierce
ex: Ista est lex omnis lepræ et percussuræ,
This is the law of every kind of leprosy and stroke.

words.g: at any time; -ever, -soever; appended to give generalized/indefinite force
ex: And when she is departed, and marrieth another husband,

words.g: seven
ex: In the seventh year thou shalt make a remission,

words.g: write; compose
ex: Pilate answered: What I have written, I have written.

words.g: eat up/away, chew up; finish eating; fret, chafe
ex: Eat not the things that are unclean.

words.g: offer; present; cause
ex: Shall offer sacrifices after the same rite.

words.g: sea; sea water
ex: mare unum, boves quoque duodecim sub mari,
One sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;

words.g: fire, brightness; passion, glow of passion
ex: The voice of the Lord divideth the flame of fire:

words.g: dead, deceased; limp
ex: Novissime omnium mortua est et mulier.
Last of all the woman died also.

words.g: woman; wife; mistress
ex: Novissime omnium mortua est et mulier.
Last of all the woman died also.

words.g: strong, powerful, mighty, vigorous, firm, steadfast, courageous, brave, bold
ex: But a greater punishment is ready for the more mighty.

words.g: royal power; power; control
ex: Sed et Salomon sedet super solium regni.
Moreover, Solomon sitteth upon the throne of the kingdom.

words.g: or, or rather/else; either...or (aut...aut) (emphasizing one)
ex: aut quis prior dedit illi, et retribuetur ei?
Or who hath first given to him, and recompense shall be made him?

words.g: there, in that place; thereupon
ex: Et veni Jerusalem, et eram ibi tribus diebus.
And I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

words.g: hand over, surrender; deliver; bequeath
ex: To whom her father gave Bala, for her servant.

words.g: wife; [uxorem ducere => marry, bring home as wife]
ex: tulit Sephoram uxorem Moysi quam remiserat,
He took Sephora, the wife of Moses, whom he had sent back:

words.g: be alive, live; survive; reside
ex: Wizards thou shalt not suffer to live.

words.g: part, region; share; direction
ex: Gomor autem decima pars est ephi.
Now a gomor is the tenth part of an ephi.

words.g: prophet; spokesman/interpreter of a god; foreteller, soothsayer (L+S)
ex: The burden that Habakkuk the prophet saw.

words.g: and, as well/soon as; together with; and moreover/even
ex: mortui sunt atque percussi in conspectu Domini.
Died and were struck in the sight of the Lord.

words.g: between, among; during; [inter se => to each other, mutually]
ex: Issachar asinus fortis accubans inter terminos.
Issachar shall be a strong ass, lying down between the borders.

words.g: fear, dread, be afraid (ne + SUB = lest; ut or ne non + SUB = that ... not)
ex: Timentis Dominum, beata est anima ejus.
The soul of him that feareth the Lord is blessed.

words.g: him/her/it/ones-self; him/her/it; them (selves) (pl.)
ex: Ille autem dicebat de templo corporis sui.
But he spoke of the temple of his body.

words.g: glory, fame; ambition; renown
ex: And we rejoice at your glory.

words.g: blood; family
ex: veloces pedes eorum ad effundendum sanguinem:
Their feet swift to shed blood:

words.g: unfairness, inequality, unevenness (of terrain)
ex: Hoc enim nefas est, et iniquitas maxima.
For this is a heinous crime, and a most grievous iniquity.

words.g: opposite, directly facing, ranged against; adverse, evil, hostile; unfavorable
ex: A good man is surety for his neighbour: and he that hath lost shame, will leave him to himself.

words.g: remain, stay, abide; wait for; continue, endure, last
tent; Jewish Tabernacle; [~ capere => (augur) set up tent to make observations]
ex: And the hanging in the entry of the tabernacle:

words.g: bless; praise; speak well of
ex: Et benedicto rege, egressus est foras.
And blessing the king, he went out.

words.g: sword
ex: He despiseth fear, he turneth not his back to the sword.

words.g: just, fair, equitable; right, lawful, justified; regular, proper
ex: Hæc porta Domini: justi intrabunt in eam.
This is the gate of the Lord, the just shall enter into it.

words.g: life, career, livelihood; mode of life
ex: Quæ vita est ei qui minuitur vino?
What is his life, who is diminished with wine?

words.g: happen, come about; result (from); take place, be held, occur, arise (event)
ex: Orate vero ut hieme non fiant.
But pray ye that these things happen not in winter.

words.g: build, erect, construct, make; create; establish
ex: But Solomon built him a house,

words.g: rise, lift; grow
ex: Et surrexit, et abiit in domum suam.
And he arose, and went into his house.

words.g: man; husband; hero
ex: Pretiosior erit vir auro, et homo mundo obrizo.
A man shall be more precious than gold, yea a man than the finest of gold.

words.g: wish, want, prefer; be willing, will
ex: Quid sibi volunt homines isti apud te?
What mean these men that are with thee?

words.g: view, (range of) sight; aspect/appearance/look; perception/contemplation/survey
ex: Et placuit sermo in conspectu eorum.
And the proposal was pleasing in their sight.

words.g: fall, sink, drop, plummet, topple; be slain, die; end, cease, abate
ex: Abram fell flat on his face.

words.g: and, and also, and besides
ex: De pomis fructuum solis ac lunæ,
Of the fruits brought forth by the sun and by the moon.

words.g: send away/off; allow to go, let go/off; disband, discharge, dismiss (soldiers)
ex: I will chastise him therefore and release him.

words.g: gate, entrance; city gates; door
ex: Hæc porta Domini: justi intrabunt in eam.
This is the gate of the Lord, the just shall enter into it.

words.g: death; corpse; annihilation
ex: Qui coierit cum jumento, morte moriatur.
Whosoever copulateth with a beast; shall be put to death.

words.g: kill; destroy
ex: Sed et vos, Æthiopes, interfecti gladio meo eritis.
You Ethiopians, also shall be slain with my sword.

words.g: temple, church; shrine; holy place
ex: And he made in the temple oblique windows.

words.g: kill, murder, slaughter, slay; cut/knock down; weary, be the death/ruin of
ex: Occidit autem Jacobum fratrem Joannis gladio.
And he killed James, the brother of John, With the sword.

words.g: is it possible, surely ... not; can it be that; (question expecting negative)
ex: Et dixit David: Quid feci? numquid non verbum est?
And David said: What have I done? is there not cause to speak?

words.g: sit, remain; settle; encamp
ex: Sed et Salomon sedet super solium regni.
Moreover, Solomon sitteth upon the throne of the kingdom.

words.g: then, thereupon, at that time
ex: Nec erat tunc rex constitutus in Edom.
And there was then no king appointed in Edom.

words.g: unfriendly, hostile, harmful
ex: A good man is surety for his neighbour: and he that hath lost shame, will leave him to himself.

words.g: head; person; life
ex: Non est caput nequius super caput colubri,
There is no head worse than the head of a serpent:

words.g: bring, bear; tell/speak of; consider
ex: tulit Sephoram uxorem Moysi quam remiserat,
He took Sephora, the wife of Moses, whom he had sent back:

words.g: descend, climb/march/come/go/flow/run/hang down; dismount; penetrate/sink
ex: salvum fac temetipsum descendens de cruce.
Save thyself, coming down from the cross.

words.g: walk, take a walk, go on foot; travel, march; go about, gad
ex: Si Spiritu vivimus, Spiritu et ambulemus.
If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

words.g: search for, seek, strive for; obtain; ask, inquire, demand
ex: Nemo quod suum est quærat, sed quod alterius.
Let no man seek his own, but that which is another's.

words.g: collect/bring together/assemble/convene; flock, congregate; group
ex: et erat omnis civitas congregata ad januam.
And all the city was gathered together at the door.

words.g: altar (usu. pl.), fitting for burnt offerings; burnt offering; high altar
ex: And before it the altar of holocaust.

words.g: justice; equality; righteousness (Plater)
ex: Ideo et reputatum est illi ad justitiam.
And therefore it was reputed to him unto justice.

words.g: bread; loaf
ex: Panem nostrum quotidianum da nobis hodie.
Give us this day our daily bread.

words.g: rational; sane, of sound mind; wise, judicious, understanding
ex: The love of God is honourable wisdom.

words.g: multitude, great number; crowd; rabble, mob
ex: Placuitque sermo regi, et omni multitudini.
And the thing pleased the king, and all the people.

words.g: love, hold dear; value/esteem/favor; have special regard for
ex: I will love thee, O Lord, my strength:

words.g: drive/urge/conduct/act; spend (time w/cum); thank (w/gratias)

I give thanks to my God in every remembrance of you:

words.g: ten; (ten men)
ex: Gomor autem decima pars est ephi.
Now a gomor is the tenth part of an ephi.

words.g: trust, entrust; commit/consign; believe, trust in, rely on, confide
ex: Jesus answered them: Do you now believe?

words.g: five
pity, sympathy; compassion, mercy; pathos
ex: Deus meus misericordia ejus præveniet me.
My God, his mercy shall prevent me.

words.g: become acquainted with/aware of; recognize; learn, find to be
ex: And the way of peace they have not known.

words.g: judge; juror
ex: Thou shalt not go aside in the poor man's judgment.

words.g: city; City of Rome

But the cattle and the spoils of the cities we took for our prey.

foot; [pedem referre => to retreat]

I was an eye to the blind, and a foot to the lame.

words.g: leave/depart/quit/desert; forsake/abandon/give up; withdraw support, let down

words.g: chew, champ, masticate, gnaw; eat, devour; lay waste
ex: He added his commandments and precepts.

words.g: first, foremost/best, chief, principal; nearest/next; [in primis => especially]
ex: Hoc est maximum, et primum mandatum.
This is the greatest and the first commandment.

words.g: turn upside down/side-to-side; invert/transpose/convulse; turn over (soil)/dig

For some are already turned aside after Satan.

words.g: good, honest, brave, noble, kind, pleasant, right, useful; valid; healthy

Labour as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

words.g: peace; harmony
ex: And the way of peace they have not known.

words.g: sun
ex: De pomis fructuum solis ac lunæ,

words.g: where, whereby

words.g: take hold, seize; grasp; take bribe

But a hair of your head shall not perish.

words.g: apiece (pl.); every; one each/at a time

And one prince of every tribe,

Through the voice of my groaning, my bone hath cleaved to my flesh.

words.g: flee, fly, run away; avoid, shun; go into exile

words.g: new, fresh, young; unusual, extraordinary; (novae res, f. pl. = revolution)

words.g: night [prima nocte => early in the night; multa nocte => late at night]

Let that night be solitary, and not worthy of praise.

words.g: lift, raise; destroy; remove, steal

words.g: judge, give judgment; sentence; conclude, decide

words.g: gold (metal/color), gold money, riches
ex: Pretiosior erit vir auro, et homo mundo obrizo.

words.g: proclaim, declare; cry/shout out; shout/call name of

words.g: mouth; face; bone

words.g: bear/carry/take/fetch/sweep/snatch away/off, remove, withdraw; steal, obtain

Fornication, and wine, and drunkenness, take away the understanding.

words.g: angel; messenger
ex: Et contestabatur angelus Domini Jesum, dicens:

words.g: turn back, go back, return; recur (usually DEP)

And returning from the battle before the sun rising,

words.g: month
ex: This day you go forth in the month of new corn.

words.g: go over, cross

And he was of necessity to pass through Samaria.

words.g: age; generation, people born at a time; breed, race
ex: Notum a sæculo est Domino opus suum.
To the Lord was his own work known from the beginning of the world.
